traceability.notes:
The story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION defines a single ESLint rule that must validate @story annotations against real .story.md files, with robust path resolution, security, configuration, performance optimization, and clear errors.
The current implementation provides the traceability/valid-story-reference rule, supporting: - Existence checks for .story.md files and correct extension (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, Core Functionality). - Safe, cached filesystem access and robust error handling mapped to fileAccessError diagnostics (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, Quality Standards). - Extraction and validation of @story annotation lines from comments (REQ-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION, integrated with the prior format-validation story 005.0). - Path resolution using ESLint context.cwd with fallback to process.cwd, plus storyDirectories handling for relative and bare paths (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS, Integration criterion). - Security validation for path traversal, absolute paths, and enforcement that resolved files remain within project boundaries (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION, REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, Security-related DoD items). - Caching of file existence results per lint run to avoid repeated IO (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION).
These behaviors are directly and thoroughly exercised by tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts, which is explicitly tied to this story and its requirement IDs, and all such tests pass both in isolation and as part of the full test suite. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md matches the specified behavior and configuration options.
Given the matching story content, the presence of the expected implementation and docs, the direct requirement-to-test traceability, and passing targeted and full test runs, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md are fully implemented and verified.
